initial.name: list_agents
initial.description: List your entire subagent tree: the root agent and all reachable continuable descendants, including yourself. Rows carry ids, descriptions, and status; descendant rows carry parent ids and depth from the root. Rows also include available names alongside Session ids. You can message any other agent in the subagent tree listed as running or inactive. running means it is working; inactive means it is not currently working. While you remain active, you will be notified when a direct child finishes; there is no need to keep checking its status. Use send_message to continue the conversation.

initial.name: send_message
initial.description: Send a message to an agent. A working agent receives it at its next step; an idle agent starts a new turn with it. Returns delivery confirmation, not the agent's answer.

name.description: The full agent path (such as lead/reviewer) or Session id of another member of your subagent tree.

message.description: The message to deliver to the agent.

changes.name: team_task_create
changes.description: Create one unowned pending task on the shared Team task board.

description.description: Complete task details and acceptance criteria.

blocked_by.description: Task ids that must complete first.

write_scopes.description: Advisory workspace-relative file or directory prefixes this task expects to modify.

changes.name: team_task_get
changes.description: Read the complete latest value of one shared task before changing or executing it.

changes.name: team_task_list
changes.description: List shared tasks, including readiness, owner, revision, blockers, and write-scope warnings.

owner.description: Optional exact ownerName filter; use unowned for tasks without an owner.

limit.description: Number of rows, 1 through 100. Defaults to 50.

changes.name: team_task_update
changes.description: Compare-and-set a shared task action using the latest revision from team_task_get or team_task_list.

expected_revision.description: Current task revision used as the CAS precondition.

write_scopes.description: Replacement advisory write scopes for edit.

owner.description: Agent name or Session id of the root or any continuable descendant for root-only reassign; omit to unassign.
